label: WHOLLY_GOOD_1: never permits what would be strictly better prevented
definition: OutcomeStandard s W: every Rowe-wholly-good being, for every occurring event it can prevent, is such that preventing the event is not strictly better than permitting it. The act-consequentialist pattern applied to permitting.
note: Analyst formulation for the trolley pilot (owner direction 2026-11-28), attribution deferred. See docs/notes/trolley-principles.md.
